Name: Seasonal Anime Portraits for Alesia by DawnWander
Author: BladeOfGrass445
Description:
This is a simple mod which hosts seasonal portraits for anime Alesia by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/133808923]DawnWander[/url].
I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19349]Dawn's Anime Portrait for Alesia SVE[/url] as a base and added seasonal outfits based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34490210]DonutSteelPeas[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24527]SVE Alesia Seasonal Anime Potraits[/url].

Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/133808923]DawnWander[/url] for letting me use their Anime Portrait and multiple thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34490210]DonutSteelPeas[/url] also for the design of the seasonal outfits.


I do not own the original anime portrait of Alesia (credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/133808923]DawnWander[/url]).
I did not design the outfits (credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34490210]DonutSteelPeas[/url]).
[size=4][b]
[/b][/size][size=4][b]Installation Instructions:[/b][/size]
Move the files to "Seasonal Outfits for SVE's" assets/Portraits/Alesia, replacing the original portraits.

Downloads.Description: Portraits go to "Seasonal Outfits for SVE" assets/Potraits /Alesia
